review_volume_boundary.definitions: U unique raw answer hashes, D disagreements with completed initial judgments (0 <= D <= U); default two initial reviewers. U and D not known before inference.
review_volume_boundary.infrastructure_retry_upper_bound: 4*U + 3*D; each initial actor at most two invocations, arbiter initial+dependent phases share at most one infrastructure retry
review_volume_boundary.separate_from: Model inference sample denominator; duplicate raw answer reuse does not delete model evaluation samples
